title: Kpalongo Cycles
style: Tribal highlife jazz with syncopated guitar chatter, rolling hand drums, and a bouncing 808 pulse; verse rides nimble bass and highlife guitar, pre-chorus thins to congas and brushed ride, chorus opens with brass hits, call-and-response chants, and stacked harmony. Lead vocal stays close-mic and playful, with crowd replies, short delay throws, and percussive ad-libs. Ear candy: whistle pickups, drum fills into each chorus, and a final horn lift. Bright, earthy, and punchy, highlife, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We step in circles by the market stall
Tin cup shining by the painted wall
Your heel taps out a secret code
Dust on the floor, but the groove still rose
Hand drum talking, then the bass replied
Every little turn got the room on side

[Pre-Chorus]
Round and round, don't break the chain
Count it once, then count again
When the night leans in that way
We don't leave, we sway, we stay

[Chorus]
Kpalongo cycles, spin me right
Kpalongo cycles, hold me tight
Round that fire, we come alive
Kpalongo cycles, keep it alive (keep it alive)

[Verse 2]
Trumpet bends like a laughing face
Guitar clicks in with a quick embrace
Your name lands soft on the backbeat groove
One small step and the whole crowd moves
Old brass clothes and a new-born pulse
Feet keep time where the river swirls

[Pre-Chorus]
Round and round, don't break the chain
Count it once, then count again
When the night leans in that way
We don't leave, we sway, we stay

[Chorus]
Kpalongo cycles, spin me right
Kpalongo cycles, hold me tight
Round that fire, we come alive
Kpalongo cycles, keep it alive (keep it alive)

[Bridge]
Let the elders clap the frame
Let the young ones call my name
If the moon turns one more time
I'll be yours on the downbeat line

[Final Chorus]
Kpalongo cycles, spin me right
Kpalongo cycles, hold me tight
Round that fire, we come alive
Kpalongo cycles, keep it alive (keep it alive)
Kpalongo cycles, one more round
Kpalongo cycles, shake this ground
Round that fire, we come alive
Kpalongo cycles, keep it alive (keep it alive)
